title: MechSim frame v0.4b
description: One simulation frame, produced by ms_world_frame_json() and sent to the browser.

nodes.description: beam only: [x, y, phi] of every node along the beam (x, y, phi of the body are those of the middle node).

moments.description: beam only: bending moment at every node, N m, sagging positive.

axial.description: beam only: normal force of every segment, N, tension positive.

stress.description: beam only: largest normal stress (axial plus bending), Pa.

I.description: beam only: second moment of area, m^4.

EI.description: beam only: bending stiffness, N m^2.

p1.description: World position of anchor a (load: application point).

p2.description: World position of anchor b (load: the same point as p1).

force.description: Axial force, positive = tension (spring, damper; bar: the normal force of the element that carries the most); magnitude of the force or impulse, amplitude of a harmonic load (load).

stress.description: bar only: largest normal stress (axial plus bending), Pa. A bar with one segment: |force| / A.

nodes.description: bar only: [x, y, phi] of the nodes along the bar from end a to end b (the bent shape); phi is the tangent.

pcr.description: bar only: the Euler load pi^2 E I / L^2 of the pinned bar, N. A bar buckles when its compression (negative force) reaches it.

vector.description: load only: force or impulse vector, world frame (harmonic: the instantaneous value).

moment.description: load only: moment or angular impulse (harmonic: the instantaneous value).

active.description: load only: false once an impulse has been applied (t > 0).

reaction.description: [Fx, Fy] or [Fx, Fy, M] exerted by the support on the body (rope, rod: force on end b; joints: on body a).

p1.description: rope, rod: world position of end a.

p2.description: rope, rod: world position of end b.

force.description: rope, rod: axial force, tension positive (a rod in compression is negative).

length.description: rope, rod: the length L (rope: maximum length).

taut.description: rope: false while slack; rod: always true.
